_about: Provenance for every data file partkiln ships. The loader (partkiln.data) refuses a file whose entry lacks any of source, licence, retrieved - a table with no paper trail is not a standard, it is a guess.

clearance_holes.csv.notes: Verbatim copy, renamed only. Columns Size,Close,Normal,Loose = the fine/medium/coarse clearance series of ISO 273. 90 rows M1-M105 as shipped by bd_warehouse.

tap_holes.csv.authority: ISO 2306:1972 tap-drill practice, as tabulated by bd_warehouse
tap_holes.csv.units: mm (metric rows); the imperial rows carry inch fractions in Size
tap_holes.csv.notes: Verbatim copy, renamed only. Size embeds the pitch (M6-1, M6-0.75); Soft/Hard are the drill diameters for soft and hard materials. 99 rows, metric and unified.

drill_sizes.csv.authority: ANSI/ASME B94.11M letter and number drill sizes
drill_sizes.csv.notes: Verbatim copy, renamed only. Letter (A-Z) and number (#1-#80) drills; Diameter is in inches, converted to mm at the lookup boundary. 106 rows.

iso4762.csv.authority: ISO 4762:2004 (hexagon socket head cap screws); ASME B18.3 for the unified rows
iso4762.csv.notes: Verbatim copy, renamed only - the header keeps bd_warehouse's trailing spaces ('iso4762:dk '), the loader strips them. dk head diameter, k head height, s hex key, t key engagement, short/long the nominal length range. 57 rows.

iso4014_4017.csv.authority: ISO 4014:2011 (hexagon head bolts), ISO 4017:2014 (hexagon head screws), DIN 931
iso4014_4017.csv.notes: Verbatim copy, renamed only. Per standard: k head height, s across flats, short/long the nominal length range. 29 rows M1.6-M64.

iso4032.csv.notes: Verbatim copy, renamed only. Per standard: m nut height, s across flats; an empty cell means that standard does not table the size. 31 rows.

iso7089.csv.authority: ISO 7089:2000 (normal), ISO 7091 (normal, product grade C), ISO 7093 (large), ISO 7094 (extra large)
iso7089.csv.notes: Verbatim copy, renamed only. Per standard: d1 inner, d2 outer, h thickness; an empty cell means that standard does not table the size. 33 rows.

iso261_pitch.csv.authority: ISO 261:1998 / ISO 262 general-purpose metric screw threads
iso261_pitch.csv.notes: DERIVED from threadlib's THREAD_TABLE.scad by partkiln (designator + first tuple element = pitch, external rows only; internal rows carry the same pitch). Series is read off the designator form the file uses: a bare 'M6' is threadlib's coarse anchor, so every pitch equal to that nominal's anchor is 'coarse' and every other pitch 'fine'; nominals the file never lists bare (M0.25-M0.9, M100 and up) are 'unlabelled' rather than guessed. 532 rows; nothing added.

materials.json.authority: EN 1993-1-1:2005 3.2.6 (steel design values), EN 10025-2:2019 (S275/S355 ReH), EN 10130:2006 (DC01), EN 10088-1 (1.4301 density), grade datasheet class for 100Cr6; everything else an engineering handbook range
materials.json.notes: Every value carries {value, unit, source, honesty}. honesty standard_value = the number the named standard prints; datasheet = a grade datasheet class; typical_range = a handbook range, the midpoint served with the range beside it; derived = computed here. No value was taken from a banned bulk source.
